title: Fade in
guidance: Use for a quiet entrance. The target is hidden before the cue and stays visible afterwards. Authored opacity and text visibility still apply.

title: Fade out
guidance: Use near the end of a thought. The target stays visible before the cue and hidden afterwards. Exact-end pictures hold this state under a dissolve.

title: Rise
summary: A small upward entrance with a fade.
guidance: Use once for a heading or a short group. Adds 28 px of vertical translation without replacing the authored transform. Hidden before the cue; hold afterwards.

title: Pop
summary: A compact scale entrance with a fade.
guidance: Use sparingly for one important point. Multiplies the authored scale from 0.86 to 1 around its existing transform origin; never replaces transform. Hidden before the cue; hold afterwards.

title: Cut
summary: The next scene appears at its boundary.
guidance: Use for a clear change of scene. No overlap or time removed. The first scene has no incoming boundary.

title: Dissolve
summary: Blend in over the previous scene’s held end.
guidance: The incoming scene starts at its storyboard time and fades over the outgoing exact-end picture. Total duration and audio timing stay fixed. The first scene has no incoming boundary.
